DEPTH_FLOOR_GROUP.segment_head_rule: the first bar of ANY observed segment has no prior; hard-missing, never coerced to FALSE

SUFFIX_WRAP_DEFECT.finding: np.roll(...,1) WRAPS: at index 0 the 'previous' bar is the LAST bar
SUFFIX_WRAP_DEFECT.source_comment: 'First bar has no prev - mask it later' (enricher.py:61) — no mask is ever applied
SUFFIX_WRAP_DEFECT.CONTRACT: segment head -> previous bar unavailable -> suffix output NON-VALID / NULL
SUFFIX_WRAP_DEFECT.explicit: we do NOT reproduce the source's wrap-around garbage merely because the historical function behaves that way. The source comment itself states the first bar must be masked; the availability layer enforces exactly that.

g_signals_x4.contract: OUTPUT uses INCOMING state; any_g also determines state

head.note: explicit canonical seed, NOT a 'bear_dom event occurred' claim

sig_tz_flip.SETTER_PRIORITY: SEMANTIC — exclusivity empirically refuted on 143,132 bars (20,561 co-firing); changing the order would change the feature definition
sig_tz_flip.separate_availability: tz_state availability and sig_tz_flip availability MUST be computed separately; neither attaches to the other

vbo_up.base_derivation: rolling(_MA_PERIOD=20) fully valid at age 20; bkt.shift(2) makes the current bar's dependency fully valid at 20 + 2 = 22

ATR14_VALIDITY_RULE.consistency: same convention already frozen for rsi_14 and Massive ATR14: age 1..13 initialization-sensitive, age >= 14 numerically licensed

vbo_up.RESET_OFFSET: latch_index + 11 observed bars, PROVIDED the trigger is PROVEN FALSE as required

BASE_VS_OUTPUT.rule: BASE DEPENDENCIES VALID != OUTPUT NECESSARILY VALID
BASE_VS_OUTPUT.authority_for_output: the reachable-state engine, not the depth floor
post_gap: 11 proven-FALSE observed trigger bars after a latch -> reset deterministically clears it
unobserved bars do NOT count as proven FALSE

BIT_EXACT_STABILITY_DIAGNOSTIC.why_rejected_as_authority: EWM/IIR never exactly forgets the past on a finite window, so 60 is an artefact of this sample's float convergence. Another sample could yield 57 or 73. Freezing it would be arbitrary and would amount to inventing a tolerance.
BIT_EXACT_STABILITY_DIAGNOSTIC.warning: this number must NEVER be carried into a contract
